title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: From the quiet stacks of Ladd Library to the sun-drenched Perry Atrium, Bates College offers a variety of environments for focused academic work and collaborative projects.

cards.title: Ladd Library Third Floor
cards.subtitle: Quiet Individual Study
cards.notes: Head to the third floor for the most silent environment in the library. It features individual carrels and the reservable Salter Room for focused thesis work.
cards.short_summary: The quietest floor of the main campus library, ideal for deep concentration and independent research.
cards.evidence_claim: The third floor of Ladd Library is described as a quiet environment with plenty of seating options, including private study space and the reservable Salter Room.
cards.source_title: Library's Group Study Rooms - Bates College
cards.access_notes: Open to students with Bates ID; hours vary by semester but typically include late night access until midnight or 2am.

cards.title: Perry Atrium
cards.subtitle: Sunlit Social Study
cards.notes: Enjoy views of Lake Andrews through the three-story glass wall. This 8,000-square-foot space features Thomas Moser furniture and a soothing waterfall fountain.
cards.short_summary: A massive, glass-walled atrium in Pettengill Hall known for its natural light and views of 'The Puddle.'
cards.evidence_claim: Perry Atrium is an 8,000-square-foot three-story glass atrium in Pettengill Hall overlooking Lake Andrews, featuring Thomas Moser furniture and a waterfall fountain.
cards.source_title: Pettengill Hall | Campus Tour - Bates College
cards.access_notes: Accessible during building hours; Pettengill Hall typically closes to students at 2am.

cards.title: Bonney Science Center Lounges
cards.subtitle: Modern Collaborative Space
cards.notes: Utilize the newest building on campus for its modern lounges and 'science on display' design. Great for group work between STEM labs.
cards.short_summary: Bates' newest academic building offering contemporary study lounges and collaborative spaces for all students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Bonney Science Center is a community hub with classrooms and study space for all to use, featuring teaching spaces and research labs.
cards.source_title: Bonney Science Center | Campus Tour - Bates College
cards.access_notes: Open to students with Bates ID during building hours.

cards.title: Commons Mezzanine
cards.subtitle: Dining Hall Study
cards.notes: Find a quieter spot for a working lunch on the mezzanine level of the dining hall. It offers a more secluded feel than the main floor.
cards.short_summary: The upper level of the central dining hall, providing a quieter alternative for students who like to study while they eat.
cards.evidence_claim: Commons offers dining spaces including a smaller and quieter mezzanine level and a Fireplace Lounge on the second level.
cards.access_notes: Accessible during dining hall operating hours; requires meal plan or payment for entry.

cards.title: Gomes Chapel
cards.subtitle: Contemplative Quiet
cards.notes: Visit for absolute silence and architectural beauty. Meditation cushions are available in the front pews for quiet reflection or reading.
cards.short_summary: A historic Gothic chapel providing a serene and silent environment for contemplation and quiet study.
cards.evidence_claim: The Peter J. Gomes Chapel is open daily from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. for contemplation and reflection, with meditation cushions in the front pews.
cards.source_title: Quiet Places On Campus | Multifaith Chaplaincy - Bates College
cards.access_notes: Open daily 7am-11pm for Bates ID holders; community access by appointment.

cards.title: Chase Hall Student Lounge
cards.subtitle: Central Student Hub
cards.notes: Located on the ground floor (G02), this lounge serves as a popular social and study space near the 'Little Room' gaming area.
cards.short_summary: A versatile student lounge in the historic Chase Hall, ideal for casual studying and meeting friends.
cards.evidence_claim: The Campus Life Student Lounge (G02) in Chase Hall is a popular social and study space for students.
cards.source_title: Student Spaces on Campus | Campus Life - Bates College
cards.access_notes: Accessible during Chase Hall building hours.

cards.title: Hedge Hall Lounges
cards.subtitle: Humanities Study Nooks
cards.notes: Find cozy lounge areas on the upper floors or use the basement computer lab. These spots are convenient for students in the humanities.
cards.short_summary: Quiet lounges and a computer lab located within the renovated Hedge Hall, home to several academic departments.
cards.evidence_claim: Hedge Hall has numerous classrooms and lounge areas (Hedge 105, 303, 304, G16) available for student use.
cards.source_title: Student Spaces on Campus | Campus Life - Bates College
cards.access_notes: Open during academic building hours for student use.

cards.title: Roger Williams Hall Lounges
cards.subtitle: Global Education Hub
cards.notes: Study in the lounges of this award-winning renovated building. It's a quiet spot for language students and those planning off-campus study.
cards.short_summary: Quiet study lounges located in the building that houses foreign languages and the Center for Global Education.
cards.evidence_claim: Roger Williams Hall features several common area study spaces (G02, H206, H225, H306, H404) available to students.
cards.source_title: Student Spaces on Campus | Campus Life - Bates College
cards.access_notes: Accessible during building hours; lounges often fill up early in the evening.

cards.title: Muskie Archives Upstairs
cards.subtitle: Historic Event Space
cards.notes: When not in use for events, the upstairs area offers comfy furniture and a large, quiet space for studying among college history.
cards.short_summary: A large, quiet upstairs room in the Muskie Archives building, featuring comfortable seating and a scholarly atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: The upstairs of the Muskie Archives hosts a large event space with comfy furniture that can hold approximately 120 people.
cards.source_title: Muskie Archives | Campus Events, Conferences & Summer Programs - Bates College
cards.access_notes: Open during archive hours; check for scheduled events which may close the space.

cards.title: Olin Arts Center Room 128
cards.subtitle: Arts-Focused Study
cards.notes: Use this designated classroom space for studying outside of academic hours. It's a great alternative for those near the arts quad.
cards.short_summary: A classroom in the Olin Arts Center specifically identified as available for student study outside of scheduled classes.
cards.evidence_claim: Olin Arts Center Room 128 is listed as a classroom study space available to students for studying outside of academic use.
cards.source_title: Student Spaces on Campus | Campus Life - Bates College
cards.access_notes: Available for study when classes are not in session during building hours.
